question: Daylight duration and nighttime duration add up to 24 hours. At a certain location on a certain day, daylight lasts 14 hours 30 minutes. How many hours does nighttime last? (Express your answer as a decimal.)
solution: 14 hours 30 minutes = 14.5 hours. Nighttime duration = \(24-14.5=9.5\) hours.
